parts.text: {"description": "Select up to 200 work items on a board and transition them in one action, with a per-item result list and a summary of failures.", "acceptance_criteria": "- Given a board with items, when the user selects up to 200 and transitions them, then each item moves or reports its failure.\n- Given an invalid input, when the action runs, then an error is reported and nothing changes.\n- Given a timeout during the action, when it is retried, then no duplicate result appears.", "changed": true, "rationale": "Applied the edge_cases operation: tightened phrasing and kept every fact."}
